lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Haha. To be honest, I didn't expect you to be this strong.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: You even banged me up a little bit.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Anyway, I suppose it's time to wrap this up.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Did... you come to save me?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Rapi? Why, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
I-it's me.
Don't you remember me?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
I-is it because we've only met once?
That... mission where we were looking for the missing squad...

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Then why are you pointing your gun at me...

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
I don't know why she's doing this.
We can talk this out.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: C-Commander... do you not remember me either?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: This is the bandage you wrapped when I was hurt.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
You know.
I've never taken this bandage off.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: It was the first time in my life anyone had ever been kind to me.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: The first time I felt warm inside.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Even when the bandage was coming off, I never swapped it for a new one.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: I thought it would be nice if you wrapped it.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
C-Commander.
Can you wrap my bandage again?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Why? Why are you acting like this?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
I'm the Commander's Nikke.
Names do not mean anything.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Commander, can you give me a name?
A tentacle extends from Modernia and pierces Rapi's stomach.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: That's what she gets for interfering with our little moment.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: If you like the Commander so much, then be with me. We can be loved together.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: You and I will become one.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: ... Are you going to shoot me?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
Haha. I know you, Commander.
You can't shoot me.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: You couldn't shoot me then, and you can't shoot me now.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text:
You're a warm person.
A kind person.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Now. Put down your gun and come here and wrap my bandage.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Do you know what will happen to me if you shoot me with that bullet?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Are you prepared to kill me?
Modernia slowly bows her head forward.
She has caught the bullet in-between her teeth.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: How... how could you do that to me?
I feel a warm sensation in my stomach.
I start losing strength in my legs.
The tentacle has pierced my stomach and appears as if its connected to it.
On the ground, there is a puddle of blood.
It is clearly a mortal wound.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: You're all trying to kill me.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: The Commander, and all of you.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: I don't need any of you.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Damn it! Why don't you just die?!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text:
Code released.
Temporary operation of sub generator.
Rapi's head starts to glow red.
Rapi grabs the tentacle embedded in her body.
There is a loud crack as she snaps the tentacle in half.
Rapi hurls the fragment of the torn tentacle with all of her strength.
It flies in a straight line towards Modernia's face.
The fragment smashes directly into Modernia's face.
The protector that was covering part of her face comes off.
At the same time, a black light seeps out of Modernia's body.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Focus your fire! Aim for the head!
An ominous light burst out like an explosion.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: ... You want to be a Commander?

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: Why would you wanna be something like that?

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: I heard they don't make much money, and it's really dangerous.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: Also, isn't their average lifespan only like thirty years? It's really short, anyway.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: And yet, you still want to be a Commander?
It's my dream to be surrounded by beautiful women.
I want to save those poor girls.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: That's quite the dream. Are you sure it's not a little too big?

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: Well, I'll root for you anyway. And your dream.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: And this is a big if...

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: If I ever become a Nikke...

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: I hope you'll be my Commander.
The parts covering Modernia fall to the ground.
The parts disappear as if being blown away by the wind.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text:
Now is our chance!
Let's finish it!

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text: It's Marian! Can you hear my voice?

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text:
Rapi! Anis!
The Commander needs first aid. Help me!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text:
Grab on that side!
Stop the bleeding!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They are stable, but they have lost a lot of blood. We need to get them back to the Ark!
The half of what's left of Chatterbox falls down from the sky.
Chatterbox is being blown apart, fragments breaking off everywhere.
Its body contorts as it desperately fights to change direction.
Chatterbox is caught in a hale of bullets.
Marian's shrill cry can be heard.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: She was back... She was back, damn it...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: A suppression bullet. Let's get her back to the Ark.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: End of engagement. All Raptures nearby are retreating.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text:
I-I don't know.
Success or failure...
Snow White's eyes move with lightning speed.
she stays still and closes her eyes.
Snow White rolls on the ground from the punch thrown by Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text:
You said leave it to you!
We trusted you!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text:
How could you let him beat you?!
You should have held him back!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You should have risked your life to stop him!!
